comparison: Both evaluations support the parameter estimates (C13-C15) derived from experimental methods. Perfect claim overlap (C30-C31, C65-C66, C71-C72). OpenEval finds the evidence SUPPORTED, while peer reviewers mark it UNCERTAIN due to limited generalizability concerns ('only shown for a small number of stem cell types'), though they accept the specific experimental results.
Perfect claim overlap (C55-C56) on temporal observations of colony establishment. Both evaluations support these observational data without concerns.

High overlap on background claims (C1-C2, C7-C12, C48-C49, C54). Both evaluations support these established facts. OpenEval also includes C63-C64 about zfp-1, which peer reviewers evaluated separately in R13.
High overlap (C45-C47) on speculative and comparative claims. Both evaluations support these as reasonable interpretations and hypotheses appropriately contextualized within prior literature.

Strong overlap (C27-C29, C62) on simulation-experiment agreement. Both evaluations support the modeling approach. OpenEval additionally evaluates C69-C70 on stochastic elimination mechanisms, which peer reviewers addressed separately in R17.
Strong overlap (C6, C75-C79) on differential regulation between colony and homeostasis contexts. Both evaluations support this core distinction and the interpretation of feedback mechanisms.

Overlap on specialized neoblast observations (C22-C24). Both evaluations support these findings. OpenEval additionally evaluates C25-C26 on colony establishment failure, which peer reviewers addressed separately in R11.

Overlap on gene expression analyses (C35-C40). Both evaluations support this evidence. OpenEval additionally evaluates C32-C34 and C52 on proliferation/death measurements and feedback interpretation, which peer reviewers addressed in R6 and R10.

Overlap on lack of compensatory lineage production (C4, C50-C51, C73-C74). Both evaluations support this finding. OpenEval additionally evaluates C3, C5 on core findings and cell-intrinsic model, which peer reviewers addressed in R2.

Overlap on normalized cycling/mitotic proportions (C19-C21). Both evaluations support this evidence. OpenEval additionally evaluates C16-C18 on colony size reduction and C63-C64 on zfp-1 context, which peer reviewers addressed in R3 and R13 respectively.

Partial overlap on speculative hypotheses (C80-C81). OpenEval marks these as UNCERTAIN due to extending beyond experimental evidence, while peer reviewers support them as part of the overall conclusions ('important new perspective'). OpenEval also evaluates C43-C44 which peer reviewers addressed in R16.

Overlap on model assumptions (C42, C57-C58). Both evaluations support the model framework. Peer reviewers emphasize the cell-intrinsic, memory-free model as a key advance.
Overlap on zfp-1 ablation and colony size reduction (C16-C18). Both evaluations support this experimental evidence as particularly important and intriguing.
Overlap on model assumptions about memory and coordination (C59-C60). Both evaluations support these assumptions as part of the convincing modeling approach.

Overlap on stochastic elimination mechanism (C70). Both evaluations support this mechanistic interpretation as part of the convincing model.

Overlap on temporal cell death analysis (C34). Both evaluations support this measurement as part of the comprehensive experimental characterization.

Minimal overlap on neoblast heterogeneity interpretation (C53). Both evaluations support this conclusion as part of the model's success and important new perspective.
Minimal overlap on model validation (C41). Both evaluations support the model's agreement with experimental data as part of the convincing approach.
Minimal overlap on model framework (C69). Both evaluations support the stochastic model without memory/coordination assumptions as a key finding.
Minimal overlap on zfp-1 background (C63-C64). Both evaluations support this established context as appropriate foundation for the study.
